args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute GUMMY CRAB: a plump translucent coral-red gummy crab with two big round claws, tiny eyes on stalks and a happy little smile. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Side view facing left. Frames: (1)-(4) sideways scuttling cycle with claws down, mid, up, mid; (5)-(6) claws raised high and body crouched ready to dash (a warning pose); (7)-(8) dizzy and squashed flat with spiral eyes. Each creature is about 16 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
